about_the_game:
🌿 MOW THE LAWN WITH YOUR FRIENDS!
Invite your friends, start up your lawnmowers, and enjoy shaping lush gardens together. A relaxing, stress-free gaming experience awaits you!

🌳 CALM AND RELAXING ATMOSPHERE
Enjoy mowing lawns in a peaceful environment with simple and straightforward mechanics. Unwind from your daily stress in a laid-back single-player career mode, or online co-op mode with your friends.

🛠️ UPGRADE AND CUSTOMIZE YOUR EQUIPMENT
Use the money you earn to upgrade and customize 4 different lawnmowers to fit your style! You can also change your character’s appearance to reflect your personality.

🏡 VARIETY OF GARDENS AWAIT YOU
Create fresh and tidy environments by mowing lawns at various locations, including residential gardens, grand mansions, and corporate buildings. Choose your spot and start mowing!

👥 1-4 PLAYER ONLINE CO-OP
The game's most important feature is the relaxing and enjoyable online co-op mode with friends! Gardening has never been this entertaining. Complete tasks together and share the fun.

🎨 EYE-CATCHING MID-POLY GRAPHICS
The game awaits you with pleasant visuals and moderately realistic graphics, perfectly complementing its relaxing atmosphere.

⏳ COMING SOON!
The game hasn't been released yet, but it's coming soon! Add it to your Wishlist to stay updated and be one of the first to experience the joy of mowing!

Don’t forget to Wishlist for a relaxing mowing experience with your friends! 🌿

name: MowIt : Grass Cutting Simulator

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-4440 (3.1 GHz) or AMD FX-6300
  • Memory: 8192 MB MB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 960 (4 GB)
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 5.120 MB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX-compatible
  • VR Support: Not supported
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: AMD Ryzen 5 3600 (3.6 GHz)
  • Memory: 16384 MB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1660 (6 GB)
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 5.120 MB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX-compatible
  • VR Support: Not supported
